categories.use_es: Sirven para sumar una idea nueva que apoya o amplía lo que ya dijiste.
categories.tip_es: Al inicio de oración llevan coma: 'Furthermore, ...'. 'As well as' y 'along with' van seguidos de sustantivo o -ing, no de una oración completa.

items.ex: The hotel was cheap. In addition, it was very close to the beach.
items.note_es: Con coma después. 'In addition to' + sustantivo/-ing: 'In addition to studying, she works.'

items.ex: The project was late. Further, the final cost was much higher than planned.
items.note_es: Como conector es formal y poco común; 'Furthermore' es más natural.

items.ex: The car broke down on the highway, and then my phone battery died too.
items.note_es: Normalmente indica secuencia (y luego); como 'añadir' es informal y oral.

items.ex: One reason to learn English is travel. Another is getting a better job.
items.note_es: 'Another' + sustantivo singular (another reason); en plural usa 'other' (other reasons).

items.ex: Bogotá has great museums. It also has many parks and bike paths.
items.note_es: Va antes del verbo principal y después de 'be': 'She is also...'. 'Also,' al inicio es informal.

items.ex: She plays the guitar as well as the piano and the drums.
items.note_es: + sustantivo o -ing: 'as well as studying'.

items.ex: I don't want to go out tonight. Besides, it's already too late.
items.note_es: 'Besides' (además) no es 'beside' (al lado de).

items.ex: The plan is too expensive. Furthermore, it would take years to complete.
items.note_es: Muy común en ensayos; siempre con coma después.

items.ex: The new phone is lighter. Moreover, its battery lasts twice as long.
items.note_es: Formal; añade un argumento más fuerte que el anterior.

items.ex: The restaurant was cheap. What's more, the food was absolutely delicious.
items.note_es: Típico de conversación y textos informales.

items.ex: I love salsa music, and my brother loves it too.
items.note_es: Va al final de la oración, no al inicio.

items.ex: She is not only a great teacher but also a talented writer.
items.note_es: Si 'Not only' abre la oración hay inversión: 'Not only did she win, but she also...'

items.ex: The course is free. Additionally, students receive a certificate at the end.
Along with her degree, she has three years of work experience.
items.note_es: + sustantivo, no oración completa.

categories.use_es: Muestran que dos ideas, personas o cosas se parecen o se diferencian.
categories.tip_es: 'Similarly,' y 'Likewise,' unen oraciones (con coma). 'Unlike', 'compared to' e 'instead of' van seguidos de sustantivo o -ing, no de sujeto + verbo.

items.ex: Bogotá is cool all year. In comparison, Cartagena is hot and humid.
items.note_es: 'In comparison with/to' + sustantivo: 'In comparison with Cali, ...'

items.ex: Just as plants need water, children need attention and love.
items.note_es: + cláusula (sujeto + verbo).

items.ex: Coffee is important to Colombia's economy. Similarly, cocoa is vital for Ghana.
Teachers must arrive on time. Likewise, students should not be late to class.
The exam wasn't difficult. On the contrary, it was surprisingly easy.
items.note_es: Sirve para negar lo anterior, no para comparar dos cosas distintas (para eso usa 'on the other hand').

items.ex: Instead of taking the bus, we walked to the university.
items.note_es: + sustantivo o -ing: 'instead of going'.

items.ex: Unlike her sister, Laura loves spicy food and hot sauce.
items.note_es: + sustantivo o pronombre, no cláusula.

items.ex: City life is exciting. On the other hand, it can be very stressful.
items.note_es: Presenta el otro lado de un tema; no significa 'además'.

items.ex: Muscles grow with exercise. In the same way, the brain improves with practice.
Compared to last year, our sales have increased by twenty percent.
items.note_es: 'Compared with' también es correcto; + sustantivo.

items.ex: Grammar is important. Equally, you need to practice speaking every day.
items.note_es: Como conector va al inicio con coma; también es adverbio: 'equally important'.

items.ex: Similar to Spanish, Italian has thousands of words that come from Latin.
items.note_es: + sustantivo.

items.ex: Both Medellín and Cali are famous for their warm weather and friendly people.
items.note_es: El verbo va en plural: 'Both Ana and Luis are...'

items.ex: My new phone is the same as yours, but it's a different color.
items.note_es: Siempre 'the same as', nunca 'the same than'.

categories.use_es: Destacan una idea porque es más importante, más sorprendente o más cierta que las demás.
categories.tip_es: Al inicio de oración llevan coma ('In fact, ...'). 'Especially' y 'even' van justo antes de la palabra que destacan, no al inicio con coma.

items.ex: I love Latin music, in particular salsa and cumbia from the Caribbean coast.

items.es: Lo importante es que / de forma importante
items.ex: The medicine is cheap. Importantly, it has very few side effects.
items.note_es: Muy común como 'More importantly,' o 'Most importantly,'.

items.ex: I don't mind the rain at all. In fact, I really enjoy it.
I love tropical fruit, especially mangoes and passion fruit.
items.note_es: No se usa al inicio de la oración con coma; va antes de lo que resalta.

items.ex: A good leader must be honest and, above all, a good listener.
Prices went up last year. Significantly, food became thirty percent more expensive.
items.note_es: Como conector es formal; es más común como adverbio: 'significantly higher'.

items.ex: Everyone danced at the wedding. Even my grandmother got up and danced.
items.note_es: Va antes de la palabra que enfatiza.

items.ex: Without a doubt, this is the best arepa I have ever eaten.
The test was very hard. Indeed, only five students passed it.
items.note_es: Confirma y refuerza lo anterior.

items.ex: Clearly, the team needs a new coach after so many losses.
Several countries, notably Colombia and Peru, have increased their coffee exports.
Undoubtedly, technology has changed the way we learn languages.
Learning English certainly takes time, but it is worth the effort.
I miss my family, but most of all I miss my mother's cooking.

categories.use_es: Presentan una idea opuesta o inesperada en relación con lo anterior.
categories.tip_es: 'Despite / in spite of' + sustantivo o -ing; 'although / even though' + sujeto y verbo. 'However,' va al inicio con coma; para unir dos oraciones con 'however' usa punto y coma: '...; however, ...'.

items.es: En contraste con / a diferencia de
items.ex: In contrast to the city, the countryside is quiet and peaceful.
items.note_es: + sustantivo; 'In contrast,' solo (con coma) une dos oraciones.

items.ex: In spite of the heavy rain, we went to the football match.
items.note_es: + sustantivo o -ing, nunca + sujeto y verbo (no: 'in spite of it was raining').

items.ex: You can take a taxi to the airport. Alternatively, there is a cheap shuttle bus.
items.note_es: Presenta otra opción más que un contraste fuerte.

items.ex: Despite feeling tired, she finished her homework before dinner.
items.note_es: Despite + sustantivo/-ing, nunca + sujeto y verbo. Nunca 'despite of'.

items.ex: My brother loves football, whereas I prefer basketball.
items.note_es: Une dos cláusulas que contrastan; normalmente con coma antes.

items.ex: Although it was late, we decided to watch another episode.
items.note_es: + sujeto y verbo. No uses 'but' en la misma oración (no: 'Although..., but...').

items.ex: I wanted to go to the concert, but the tickets were sold out.
items.note_es: En escritura formal evita empezar la oración con 'But'.

items.ex: The course was expensive. However, it was worth every peso.
items.note_es: No une dos oraciones solo con coma: usa punto o punto y coma antes.

items.ex: Even though he studied a lot, he failed the driving test.
items.note_es: Más enfático que 'although'; + sujeto y verbo.

items.ex: The road was dangerous. Nevertheless, the bus driver continued the journey.
While some people love winter, others can't stand the cold.
items.note_es: También significa 'mientras' (tiempo); aquí expresa contraste.

items.ex: The village is very small, yet it has three excellent restaurants.
items.note_es: Como conector va entre cláusulas, parecido a 'but' pero más enfático.

items.ex: The weather was terrible. Nonetheless, thousands of fans attended the concert.
Renting is flexible. On the other hand, buying a house is a long-term investment.
items.note_es: Mejor si antes usaste 'On the one hand'.

categories.use_es: Cierran un texto o una idea resumiendo lo más importante.
categories.tip_es: Van al inicio del último párrafo o de la última oración, seguidos de coma: 'In conclusion, ...'. Usa solo uno por texto.

items.ex: To conclude, regular exercise improves both physical and mental health.
In brief, the project was a success despite a few small problems.
As shown above, most students prefer online classes in the evening.
items.note_es: Solo en textos escritos que ya presentaron tablas o datos.

items.ex: So, after everything we discussed today, I think we should accept the offer.
items.note_es: Para cerrar es informal; en ensayos usa 'therefore' o 'in conclusion'.

items.ex: The evidence is clear; therefore, the city must invest in public transport.
items.note_es: Después de punto o punto y coma, y con coma después.

items.ex: On the whole, the trip was great, although the hotel was noisy.
To sum up, social media has both clear advantages and serious risks.
Overall, I would recommend this course to any beginner.
In conclusion, learning English opens many doors for young Colombians.
items.note_es: Úsalo una sola vez, en el último párrafo.

items.ex: All in all, it was a fantastic weekend with my friends.
To summarise, the three main problems are cost, time and lack of training.
items.note_es: 'To summarize' es la ortografía americana; ambas son correctas.

items.ex: Ultimately, the decision to study abroad depends on your goals and budget.
In summary, the results show a clear improvement in reading skills.

categories.use_es: Introducen ejemplos concretos que aclaran o demuestran una idea general.
categories.tip_es: 'For example,' y 'For instance,' pueden abrir una oración (con coma). 'Such as', 'like' e 'including' van en medio, seguidos directamente de los ejemplos (sustantivos), sin coma después.

items.ex: Some English words are hard to pronounce. For example, 'thought' has a difficult sound.
Some jobs require excellent English. For instance, pilots must talk to control towers.
Colombia exports products such as coffee, flowers and bananas.
items.note_es: + sustantivos; no abre una oración independiente.

items.ex: To illustrate, a single plastic bottle can take hundreds of years to decompose.
items.note_es: Común en ensayos y presentaciones.

items.ex: I enjoy outdoor activities like hiking, cycling and camping.
items.note_es: Más informal que 'such as'; en ensayos formales prefiere 'such as'.

items.ex: As a sample of her work, she sent the editor three short stories.
items.note_es: Poco natural como conector de ejemplo: los nativos dicen 'for example' o 'as an example'. 'Sample' es 'muestra' (de un producto o de un trabajo).

items.ex: Many teenagers sleep too little, as revealed by a recent national survey.
items.note_es: Introduce la fuente o la evidencia, no exactamente un ejemplo. Formal y escrito.

items.ex: To exemplify this point, consider how mobile phones changed family communication.
items.note_es: Muy formal y poco frecuente; 'for example' es más natural.

items.ex: Two students got perfect scores, namely Sofía and Andrés.
items.note_es: Nombra exactamente quiénes o qué son; no da ejemplos sueltos.

items.ex: We visited several cities on the coast, including Cartagena and Santa Marta.
Bring something easy to eat on the bus, e.g. sandwiches, fruit or cookies.
items.note_es: Abreviatura escrita; en voz alta di 'for example'. No la confundas con 'i.e.' (es decir).

items.ex: As an example, consider how many people now work from home.
Take Medellín, for example: its cable cars changed life in many neighborhoods.
items.note_es: Estructura: Take + sustantivo + , for example.

items.ex: Some cities are very bike-friendly; Amsterdam is a case in point.
items.note_es: Va después de la idea general: '... X is a case in point.'

categories.use_es: Expresan que algo pasa solo si se cumple otra cosa (condiciones, requisitos o precauciones).
categories.tip_es: Si la condición va primero, usa coma: 'If it rains, ...'. Después de 'if', 'unless', 'as long as' y 'in case' no uses 'will' para hablar del futuro: 'if it rains', no 'if it will rain'.

items.ex: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic at the park.
items.note_es: No uses 'will' después de 'if' para el futuro: 'If it rains' (no 'If it will rain').

items.ex: You won't pass the exam unless you study a little every day.
items.note_es: = 'if not'; no lleva otra negación: 'unless you study' (no 'unless you don't study').

items.ex: Even if it rains, the concert will continue as planned.
You can borrow my car only if you promise to drive carefully.
items.note_es: Al inicio hay inversión: 'Only if you promise will I lend it.'

items.ex: The flight was delayed for three hours because of the storm.
items.note_es: Ojo: expresa causa, no condición. + sustantivo (because of the rain); con sujeto y verbo usa 'because'.

items.ex: While you live in my house, you will follow my rules.
items.note_es: Como condición es poco común (= 'as long as'); normalmente 'while' es tiempo (mientras) o contraste (mientras que).

items.ex: We will meet in the park on Sunday, except if it is raining.
items.note_es: Poco común; 'unless' es más natural.

items.ex: The bakery is closed today? In that case, we'll buy bread tomorrow.
items.note_es: Responde a una situación que acaba de mencionarse.

items.es: Siempre y cuando / con tal de que
items.ex: You can join the school trip provided that your parents sign the form.
You can use my laptop as long as you are careful with it.
Hurry up and finish your breakfast. Otherwise, we will miss the bus.

items.es: Por si acaso / en caso de que
items.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains this afternoon.
items.note_es: Es precaución, no condición: 'in case it rains' = por si llueve (no 'si llueve').

items.ex: Suppose you won the lottery tomorrow, what would you buy first?
items.note_es: También 'Supposing...'; suele ir con condicional hipotético.

items.ex: The bank gave him the loan on condition that he paid it back within a year.

categories.use_es: Ordenan pasos, instrucciones o argumentos uno tras otro.
categories.tip_es: Al inicio de oración llevan coma: 'First, ... Next, ... Finally, ...'. No mezcles estilos: 'First, Second, Finally' o 'Firstly, Secondly, Lastly'.

items.ex: First, wash the rice well. Then cook it with water, oil and salt.
items.note_es: 'First' es más común; 'Firstly' en listas formales. No confundir con 'At first' (al principio, antes de un cambio).

items.ex: Second, make sure you have all your documents before the interview.
items.note_es: En textos formales también 'Secondly'.

items.ex: We went to the cinema. Afterward, we had pizza near the mall.
items.note_es: 'Afterward' es más americano; 'afterwards' más británico.

items.ex: Initially, the app was free, but now you have to pay for it.
Before you start the exam, write your name on every page.
items.note_es: + sujeto y verbo o -ing: 'before starting'.

items.ex: Previously, she worked as a nurse in a hospital in Cali.
Finally, add the cheese and serve the arepas while they are hot.
The company lost money in 2020 and subsequently closed two of its stores.
Next, open the app and create a new account with your email.
Mix the flour and the eggs, then add the milk slowly.
Lastly, I would like to thank my family for all their support.
To begin with, let's review the vocabulary from our last class.
We hiked for three hours. After that, we rested next to the river.
The teacher explained the rules. Following this, the students presented their projects.

categories.use_es: Explican por qué pasa algo (causa) o para qué se hace (propósito).
categories.tip_es: 'Because / since / as' + sujeto y verbo; 'because of / due to / owing to' + sustantivo. Para propósito: 'in order to / so as to' + verbo base; 'so that' + sujeto y verbo.

items.ex: She decided to stay at home, for she was feeling very tired.
items.note_es: Como conector de causa es literario y anticuado; en la vida diaria usa 'because'. Nunca abre la oración con este sentido.

items.ex: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain in the afternoon.
items.note_es: + sustantivo; con sujeto y verbo usa 'due to the fact that'.

items.ex: She saves money every month in order to travel to Europe.
items.note_es: Propósito + verbo base. Negativo: 'in order not to'.

items.ex: I wrote down the address so that I wouldn't forget it.
items.note_es: Propósito + sujeto y verbo, a menudo con can/could/would.

items.ex: The city built new bike lanes with the aim of reducing traffic.
items.note_es: + -ing.

items.ex: Bogotá gets cold at night. For this reason, always bring a jacket.
items.note_es: Introduce la consecuencia de la razón que acabas de dar.

items.ex: Owing to a technical problem, the flight was delayed for two hours.
items.note_es: + sustantivo; más formal que 'due to'.

items.ex: I'm learning English because I want to work for an international company.
items.note_es: + sujeto y verbo. En escritura no dejes una oración sola que empiece con 'Because...'.

items.ex: Since it's a public holiday, the banks are closed today.
items.note_es: También significa 'desde' (tiempo).

items.ex: As we had no money left, we walked back to the hostel.
items.note_es: Para una causa que el oyente ya conoce; también puede significar 'como' o 'mientras'.

items.ex: We stayed inside all afternoon because of the storm.
items.note_es: + sustantivo; con sujeto y verbo usa 'because'.

items.ex: He left the office early so as to avoid the traffic.
items.note_es: Negativo: 'so as not to'.

items.ex: Thanks to her help, I finally passed the English exam.
items.note_es: Para causas positivas; + sustantivo.

categories.use_es: Explican mejor, precisan o corrigen lo que acabas de decir.
categories.tip_es: Suelen ir al inicio con coma ('In other words, ...') o en medio entre comas (', that is, '). 'I mean' y 'Let me explain' son orales; en ensayos usa 'in other words' o 'that is'.

items.ex: He's not a bad player. I mean, he just needs more practice.
items.note_es: Muy común en conversación; evítalo en ensayos.

items.ex: To simplify, inflation means that your money buys less than before.
To be clear, the deadline is Friday at noon, not Friday night.
The process seems complicated, but let me explain it step by step.
items.note_es: Frase de conversación o presentación, no conector de ensayo.

items.ex: The meeting is in the morning, more precisely at eight thirty.
The tickets are sold out. In other words, we can't go to the concert.
In explanation, the manager said the delay was caused by a staff shortage.
items.note_es: Raro y poco natural; prefiere 'By way of explanation' o 'To explain'.

items.ex: To clearly define the problem, we first need to collect more data.
items.note_es: No es un conector fijo, es un infinitivo de propósito. Para aclarar usa 'that is' o 'in other words'.

items.ex: Bring an official ID, that is, your cédula or your passport.
items.note_es: En textos escritos se abrevia 'i.e.'.

items.ex: Only one problem remains, namely the lack of money for the project.
The company is losing money. To put it another way, it needs a new strategy.
What I mean is that we need more time to finish the project.
The course is for real beginners, i.e. people with no previous English.
items.note_es: Abreviatura escrita; no la confundas con 'e.g.' (por ejemplo).

items.ex: To clarify, the price includes breakfast but not dinner.

categories.use_es: Presentan la consecuencia o el efecto de lo que se dijo antes.
categories.tip_es: 'So' va en medio con coma antes: '..., so ...'. 'Therefore, consequently, as a result' suelen abrir una nueva oración con coma, o ir después de punto y coma: '...; therefore, ...'.

items.ex: He didn't study at all for the exam. As a result, he failed it.
The main bridge was closed; thus, drivers had to take a longer route.
The roads were completely flooded this morning, hence the long delay.
items.note_es: Puede ir seguido solo de un sustantivo: 'hence the delay'.

items.ex: We got lost several times, but eventually we found the hotel.
items.note_es: Falso amigo: no significa 'eventualmente' (quizás); significa 'al final, después de un tiempo'.

items.ex: The rules have changed. Accordingly, all students must now register online.
The company lost its biggest client. Consequently, fifty employees lost their jobs.
The noise from the party was such that nobody in the building could sleep.
items.note_es: Poco común; más natural: 'so loud that nobody could sleep'.

items.ex: Prices increased again; therefore, many families are buying less meat.
It was raining, so we stayed at home and watched a movie.
items.note_es: Coma antes de 'so' cuando une dos oraciones.

items.ex: As a consequence of the strike, schools were closed for a week.
items.note_es: 'As a consequence of' + sustantivo.

items.ex: The road is dangerous at night. For this reason, buses don't travel after nine.
The store opens at ten, which means that we have time for breakfast.
items.note_es: Va después de coma y se refiere a toda la oración anterior.

items.ex: I missed the early bus. That's why I was late for class.

categories.use_es: Ubican las acciones en el tiempo: antes, después, al mismo tiempo o hasta un momento.
categories.tip_es: 'During' + sustantivo; 'while' + sujeto y verbo. Después de 'when, as soon as, until, before, after' no uses 'will' para el futuro: 'when I arrive', no 'when I will arrive'.

items.ex: In the beginning, living alone was difficult, but now I love it.
items.note_es: 'At the beginning of' + sustantivo: 'at the beginning of the year'.

items.ex: We had dinner at a small restaurant, and then we went for a walk.
I'm busy right now, but I'll call you later this evening.
Mom was cooking dinner. Meanwhile, Dad was setting the table.
She works full-time and, at the same time, studies at night.
items.note_es: También puede expresar contraste: 'Sin embargo, a la vez...'.

items.ex: Please turn off your phone during the movie.
items.note_es: + sustantivo (during the class); con sujeto y verbo usa 'while'.

items.ex: Brush your teeth before you go to bed every night.
After the class, we went to a café near the university.
Call me as soon as you arrive at the airport, please.
items.note_es: No uses 'will' después: 'as soon as you arrive'.

items.ex: Please wait here until the doctor calls your name.
I usually listen to podcasts while I'm cooking dinner.
items.note_es: + sujeto y verbo, normalmente en progresivo.

items.ex: By the time we arrived, the movie had already started.
items.note_es: Suele usarse con past perfect o future perfect.

items.ex: We played football in the park, and afterwards we had ice cream.
When I was a child, I lived with my grandparents in Barranquilla.
Once you finish your homework, you can play video games.

categories.use_es: Repiten una idea con otras palabras, normalmente más simples o más cortas.
categories.tip_es: Van al inicio de la oración con coma ('In short, ...') o entre comas en medio (', that is to say, '). Informales: 'in a nutshell', 'I mean'.

items.ex: The hotel was dirty, noisy and expensive. In short, it was a terrible choice.

items.es: Para reformular / dicho de otra forma
items.ex: To rephrase my question, what exactly do you need from us?
items.note_es: Poco frecuente; más común 'Let me rephrase that' o 'To put it another way'.

items.ex: In a nutshell, the plan is to save money and travel next year.
In simple terms, a vaccine teaches your body how to fight a virus.
She's very talented. I mean, she can play five different instruments!
items.note_es: Oral; evítalo en textos formales.

items.ex: Expressed simply, the more you practice, the better you get.
items.note_es: Poco común; los nativos prefieren 'Put simply' o 'Simply put'.

items.ex: The course lasts one semester, that is to say, about four months.
Wear sunscreen at the beach. Otherwise, you will get a bad sunburn.
items.note_es: Ojo: 'otherwise' NO reformula; significa 'de lo contrario / si no' (condición). Para reformular usa 'in other words'.

items.ex: He never answers my messages. In other words, he isn't interested.
Put simply, we don't have enough money to finish the project.
The first plan failed. To put it differently, we need to start again.
Simply put, a good night's sleep is essential for learning.
I'll see you on Monday, or rather, early on Tuesday morning.
items.note_es: Sirve para corregirte a ti mismo.

items.ex: In plain English, the contract says you can't cancel for a year.

categories.use_es: Presentan opciones o alternativas entre dos o más cosas.
categories.tip_es: En 'either… or' y 'neither… nor' cada parte va justo antes de la opción: 'either tea or coffee'. 'Alternatively,' e 'In either case,' abren la oración con coma.

items.ex: You can either pay in cash or use a credit card at the counter.
items.note_es: Con dos sujetos, el verbo concuerda con el más cercano: 'Either Ana or her brothers are coming.'

items.ex: I still don't know whether to study medicine or engineering.
items.note_es: También 'whether... or not': 'whether you like it or not'.

items.ex: We could eat at home tonight. Alternatively, we could try the new Peruvian restaurant.
Do you want to watch a movie or go for a walk in the park?
I'd rather stay at home tonight than go to a noisy party.
items.note_es: 'Would rather' + verbo base + 'than': 'I'd rather stay than go'.

items.ex: For the final project, you can choose either a poster or a short video.
items.note_es: No es un conector fijo: es el verbo 'choose' + 'either… or'.

items.ex: Bring a dessert to the party, preferably fruit or something homemade.
items.note_es: No es una pareja fija: 'preferably' marca la opción preferida y 'or' añade otra.

items.es: En cualquiera de los dos casos
items.ex: You may win or lose the match. In either case, you will learn something useful.
Neither my sister nor I can swim very well.
items.note_es: No se usa 'not' con 'neither… nor' (no hay doble negación en inglés).

items.ex: There was no coffee left, so I had a cup of tea instead.
items.note_es: 'Instead' va al final o al inicio con coma; 'instead of' + sustantivo/-ing.

items.ex: We should book the tickets today. Otherwise, there won't be any good seats left.
items.note_es: Presenta lo que pasará si no se elige la primera opción.

items.ex: Whether or not you agree, the meeting will take place tomorrow.
Hurry up, or else we'll miss the beginning of the film.
items.note_es: Puede sonar a advertencia o amenaza.

items.ex: We can take the bus or a taxi; either way, we'll arrive by seven.
